name: Strength of Stone Technique
description: A notable trait of Earth is its strength and resistance to damage. After a short meditation holding and concentrating on the Essence within a pebble, the character becomes stronger and tougher, gaining one dot each of Strength and Stamina for the next five minutes. To include others, they must all hold hands in a circle with a pebble between each pair of palms. A character can benefit from only one application of Strength of Stone Technique at a time.

name: Impervious Skin of Stone Meditation
description: The Dragon-Blood's skin gains the toughness of native rock; swords and arrows glance off as if from a cliff face. Every mote invested gives the character two points of additional soak against lethal and bashing damage, but the soak bonus cannot exceed her Essence. This Charm is weak against Essence — it does not apply to damage caused by sorcery or by attacks enhanced with Charms.

name: Mountain Toppling Method
description: Links the Dragon-Blooded's Essence to the Essence within any great mass; by inverting the principles of resistance against the mass, he exerts vastly magnified strength. After a moment's concentration he can hurl boulders, topple pillars, start a landslide, or perform other momentary feats. For one turn his Strength increases by 5, but he can only apply the extra Strength to objects of earth or stone; it may be used in an attack (e.g. throwing a boulder for Strength-based damage), and jade-alloy weapons such as daiklaves count as 'stone' enough to benefit.

name: (Element) Protection Form
description: A cluster of five separate Charms, each protecting from the element of one of the Five Immaculate Dragons (this entry models the set; each must be bought separately, and a character may apply her own elemental attunement discount when learning her element's version). While in effect, the character gains a bonus to lethal and bashing soak equal to her Essence when attacked by an appropriate source of elemental damage, applying to attacks and to environmental damage (drowning, crushing rock, molten lava). For this Charm, metal counts as earth and fists, teeth, and natural attacks as wood. Like Impervious Skin of Stone Meditation, this protection is brittle — no extra resistance against Charm-enhanced attacks or sorcery.

name: Chaos-Warding Prana
description: The Dynasts of Earth, paragons of stability, combat the roiling energies of the Wyld. For the rest of the scene the Dynast may ignore the warping effects of the Wyld; both his person and his gear are protected and cannot be mutated or changed by Wyld effects. He can extend the protection to others by paying the full cost of the Charm and touching them.

name: Defense-from-Anathema Method
description: The most powerful Terrestrial Exalted shield themselves from the magic of the Anathema. For the rest of the scene the Dynast may add her Essence to the difficulty of magical attacks made against her by the Anathema, including Charm-enhanced attacks and sorcery; these act as automatic successes to avoid the attack and are additive with dodges and parries. It offers no protection against more subtle effects such as mind control.
